title: Closed points and connected components of a w-local space
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space]. Let $X^c$ be its subspace of closed points [def-weil-closed-points]. Assume that $X^c$ is closed and that whenever a point specializes to two closed points, those closed points are equal. Let $\pi_0(X)$ be the set of connected components, with its quotient topology. Then the canonical map $X^c\to\pi_0(X)$, sending a point to its connected component, is a homeomorphism.

proof.text: This is the already proved source-library theorem WLocalSpace.isHomeomorph_connectedComponents_closedPoints. Its hypotheses are precisely the WLocalSpace class: spectrality, closedness of the closed-point subset, and uniqueness of closed specializations. Its bundled homeomorphism is WLocalSpace.closedPointsHomeomorph. The source proof establishes injectivity by separating closed points using clopen generalization hulls, surjectivity by taking a closed specialization, and continuity plus compact-to-Hausdorff bijectivity gives the homeomorphism.
